scripts.ci:check: npx concurrently --names "formatting","types","knip","llms-txt" --prefix-colors "yellow,blue,magenta,cyan" "pnpm run format:check" "pnpm run types:check" "pnpm run knip" "pnpm run llms-txt:check"
